column3: writes the count (`club_history_fields::RECORD_COUNT`) and the 0x10-byte records from [+8] into the "club history.dat" item and returns 1; no container the "Error" box and 0; on open or write error the box and the game stops

Finds or adds the club's record in the competition statistics and stores the position at `comp_stats_club::FINAL_POSITION`. \n `Comp_Stats::set_club_final_position(club, pos)`: finds (`exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry`) or adds (`exe::comp_stats_add_club_entry`) the club's record in the competition statistics and stores the position (a byte) at `comp_stats_club::FINAL_POSITION`; returns the record. Null club: the error box (line 0x680).

Returns the club's side in the fixture: 1 home, 2 away, 3 neutral, from the fixture's stadium and the two clubs' stadiums (national sides: by the stadium's nation). \n `comp_util_get_fixture_venue_side(club, game)`. Without a venue in the fixture (`.stadium()`): by the home club (`fixture::HOME_CLUB`), 3 if it has no stadium (`club::STADIUM`), otherwise 1 for the home club and 2 for the other. National side (`exe::database_is_national_team`): 1 if the venue's nation (`stadium::CITY`, `city::NATION`) is the club's (`.nation()`), 2 if it is the opponent's (`club::NATION`), otherwise 3. Club: if the venue is the club's stadium and not the opponent's, 1; if it is both clubs' stadium, 1 for the home club and 2 for the other; if only the opponent's, 2; if neither's, 3. The caller reads only `al`.

Classifies a league match between two clubs: 1 = title clash, 3 = zone clash, 0 = none, from the weighted statistics ratings (`exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry`) against a third of the clubs or 0.2 × clubs + `.promoted_count()` (+ `.promotion_playoff_count()`). \n `comp_util_get_league_clash_type(a, b)`: both clubs must be in the same division (`.division()`, neither reserve nor minor: `FN_COMP_IS_RESERVE_OR_MINOR_COMP`), its league (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE[id]`) must have statistics (`.comp_stats()`, `exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry` for both), no stages (`.current_stage()` = −1) and `.comp_type()` = `comp_type::LEAGUE`, and the difference in `.current_position()` must be at most a quarter (`rdata::F64_0_25`) of the clubs (`.club_count()`). With the ratings (`league_stats_rating`): 1 = title clash (virtual `league_vtable::HAS_AUTOMATIC_PROMOTION` = 0, both below a third (`rdata::F64_0_3333333333`) of the clubs and each not below the other's `.best_position()`); 3 = zone clash (`league_vtable::HAS_AUTOMATIC_PROMOTION` ≠ 0, both up to 0.2 (`rdata::F64_0_2`) × clubs + `.promoted_count()`, or, with `.promotion_playoff_count()`, up to 0.2 × clubs + `.promoted_count()` + `.promotion_playoff_count()`, and the same cross-check of `.best_position()`); otherwise 0. Returns only `al`. No SEH, no random draw; the virtual `league_vtable::HAS_AUTOMATIC_PROMOTION` is called up to three times, as in the original.

Computes a club's strength score: money (`.cash()` / 400 or balance / 300) + 16 × reputation + the off-match ratings (`exe::match_man_score_player_for_selection`) of the 15 picked (`FN_MATCH_MAN_ASSIGN_PLAYERS_TO_POSITIONS`) from the squad; null club: −10,000,000. \n `comp_util_get_club_strength_score(club)`: the money (without the finance table `G_FINANCE_TABLE`: `.cash()` / 400; with it, the 64-bit balance / 300 via `exe::financetable_get_club_finance`), plus 16 × the reputation (`.reputation()`), plus the off-match rating (`exe::match_man_score_player_for_selection`, 0x840, limit −1) of the 15 picked players (`FN_MATCH_MAN_ASSIGN_PLAYERS_TO_POSITIONS`, codes 1, 0x804, 0x84, 3 × 0x204, 0x810, 0x90, 3 × 0x210, 4 × 0x40) among the players (`staff::PLAYER`) of the squad (`exe::database_collect_club_squad`). Null club: −10,000,000. No SEH, no random draw of its own. The original pushes the number of players as a dword with only the low byte written (the rest is stack leftover); `FN_MATCH_MAN_ASSIGN_PLAYERS_TO_POSITIONS` reads only the byte, and the copy passes the byte zero-extended.

Rebuilds the fixture from eighteen consecutive news slots and resolves its clubs, stadium and competition. \n The `fixture` is rebuilt from 18 consecutive slots of the `news` item (`exe::newsitem_get_slot`) starting at `*cursor` (which advances by 18): `fixture::HOME_CLUB_ID` and `fixture::AWAY_CLUB_ID` the clubs, `fixture::HOME_RESULT_MARK`, `fixture::AWAY_RESULT_MARK`, +4 the stadium, +0 the competition, `fixture::STAGE_INDEX`, `fixture::ROUND_PREFIX`, `fixture::ROUND_NAME`, `fixture::HOME_GOALS`/`fixture::AWAY_GOALS`, `fixture::HOME_AGGREGATE`/`fixture::AWAY_AGGREGATE` and `fixture::HOME_GOALS_EXTRA_TIME`/`fixture::AWAY_GOALS_EXTRA_TIME` the scores, `fixture::DAY`, `fixture::YEAR` and +8. Then the pointers: clubs (`G_CLUB_TABLE`, 0x245 bytes) at `fixture::HOME_CLUB`/`fixture::AWAY_CLUB`, stadium (`G_STADIUM_TABLE`, 0x4e) at `fixture::STADIUM` and competition (`G_CLUB_COMP_TABLE`, 0x6b) at `fixture::COMPETITION`; id −1: 0.

Classifies the cup tie result for the club, from the final margin, the side and the reputation gap. \n The category (1 to 7) of the tie result for the `club` in the `fixture`: the final margin (score `.home_aggregate()`/`.away_aggregate()`, or `.home_goals_extra_time()`/`.away_goals_extra_time()`, or `.home_goals()`/`.away_goals()`, the first one without 0xff) from the club's side (home = `.home_club()`) and the clubs' reputations (`.reputation()` / 500). 1 thrashing, 2 and 3 wins against stronger sides, 4 ordinary, 5 and 7 defeats to weaker sides, 6 upset. Only `al` is faithful (the caller uses `al`).

Writes the fixture's clubs, venue, competition, score and round into 18 consecutive news slots and advances the cursor. \n The community map gives the 2nd argument as unused, but it is the news item. Writes the fixture into 18 consecutive data slots of the news item (`exe::newsitem_set_slot`), starting at slot `[cursor]`, and advances the cursor by 18. Order: `fixture::HOME_CLUB_ID`, `fixture::AWAY_CLUB_ID`, `fixture::HOME_RESULT_MARK`, `fixture::AWAY_RESULT_MARK`, +4, +0, `fixture::STAGE_INDEX`, `fixture::ROUND_PREFIX`, `fixture::ROUND_NAME`, `fixture::HOME_GOALS`, `fixture::AWAY_GOALS`, `fixture::HOME_AGGREGATE`, `fixture::AWAY_AGGREGATE`, `fixture::HOME_GOALS_EXTRA_TIME`, `fixture::AWAY_GOALS_EXTRA_TIME`, `fixture::DAY`, `fixture::YEAR`, +8 (bytes and the words `fixture::ROUND_NAME`/`fixture::ROUND_PREFIX` signed; `fixture::YEAR` and `fixture::DAY` unsigned). Returns what the last write returned. The original keeps the index of the 18th slot in the low byte of the `cursor` argument itself (only the low part reaches `exe::newsitem_set_slot`).

Writes the stage and round names (with their genders, through template 0x9a7cfc), or just one of them; without an output or under 200 bytes, the error box and 0. \n `comp_util_format_stage_round_name(stage, round, out, size, style)`: without an output or with fewer than 200 bytes, the error box (line 0x26a1) and 0. Clears the output; with both stage and round, "{stage} {round}" (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF` with template 0x9a7cfc, the 100-byte names from `exe::comp_util_get_stage_name` and the genders from `exe::comp_util_get_stage_name_gender`); with only one of them, its name directly in the output (`exe::comp_util_get_stage_name` with the size); with neither, just the zero. Returns 1 (0 on the error box).

Stores competition, year and four values in the free row of the competition history (without one, grows by 20 rows through `exe::database_grow_comp_history_table`); returns the row. \n `comp_util_add_history_record(league, a, b, c, d)`: the free row of the competition history (without one, it grows by 20 rows through `exe::database_grow_comp_history_table` and uses the first new one; out of memory, 0) receives the competition (the league's +4), the year `G_CURRENT_DATE_YEAR` (+8), and the four values at `comp_history_row::CHAMPION` (+0xa), +0xe, +0x12, +0x16. Returns the row. No SEH, no random draw, no locals.

rule: the Intertoto Cup takes the 60 clubs the European rules put in it (European cup `club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = the Intertoto, `KEY_CLUB_COMP_INTER_TOTO_CUP`), in club table order; each with class = its coefficient (`club::EURO_SEEDING`), and the list is sorted by class (the seeds); with fewer than 60, the error box

Daily Intertoto update: once a season, when the Intertoto ends, its final winners (up to three, in August) enter the UEFA Cup; every day, the cup update. \n `today.update_for_date(stage)`, virtual +0x14 of the Intertoto. Once (`intertoto_cup::WINNERS_SENT_TO_UEFA` = 0), when the cup has ended (virtual `comp_vtable::CHECK_COMPLETE` with 0, 1: push 1; push 0; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 8; the low byte): without the UEFA Cup (`uefa_cup_object`), the box for line 0x29e; with it, each Intertoto team with +5 = 1 (the winners of the finals) goes, in order, into the places from `cup::TEAM_COUNT` − 27 on of the UEFA Cup's table `cup::TEAM_TABLE` (the last three places; up to three: the club, +4 and +5 zeroed) and into its entry book (`cup::ENTRANT_BOOK`, 6 bytes: the club and status 4 at +4 [inference: entry through the Intertoto]; `cup::ENTRANT_COUNT` goes up); then the UEFA predicted positions (virtual `comp_vtable::SET_PREDICTED_POSITIONS`: mov ecx, uefa -> thiscall, ret 0), `intertoto_cup::WINNERS_SENT_TO_UEFA` = 1 and the predicted positions once more (the original re-reads the UEFA Cup). Always, at the end, the cup update (`FN_CUP_UPDATE_FOR_DATE`: push stage; push today; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 8), whose return value is returned.

Records a club's Intertoto outcome in the staff records: the final winner qualifies for the UEFA Cup, a club going through gets the next round record, a club knocked out leaves European competition. 
 `club.update_staff_records_for_status(outcome, _, _, game, _)`, virtual +0x44 of the Intertoto; returns 0. Weight = `scale_by_round`(low, high, match round `fixture::ROUND_NUMBER`, rounds `.round_count()`) (cdecl, 4 pushes; add esp, 0x10). 
 - 1 (won the final): the qualification record (`european_cup_add_qualified_record`) for the UEFA Cup (the competition `G_CLUB_COMP_TABLE` + 0x6b × `KEY_CLUB_COMP_UEFA_CUP`), stage 0, round 0xa, weight(0x3c, 0x64), and the club moves to the UEFA Cup (`.set_continental_comp_id(KEY_CLUB_COMP_UEFA_CUP)`). 
 - 0 (went through a round): if the next round exists (`fixture::ROUND_NUMBER` + 1 < `.round_count()`), the qualification record in the Intertoto (+4) with the match's stage `fixture::ROUND_PREFIX`, the +7 of the next round (`.round_table()`, 0x68 bytes) and the weight round × 99 / (rounds − 1) + 1 (only the low byte is incremented: inc al). 
 - 0xff or 2 (knocked out, or lost the final): the elimination record (`european_cup_add_knocked_out_record`) in the Intertoto, stage 0, round `fixture::ROUND_NAME` of the match, weight(0x14, 0x50), and the club leaves European competition (`leave_euro_competition`: `club::CONTINENTAL_COMP_ID` = −1).

`this.on_friendly_fixture_cancelled(game, who)` (SEH frame for the local news item), called by the calendar (`add_fixture`) and by the club screen: handles a cancelled friendly fixture. \n A friendly of this competition (`.competition()` = +4): news item 8 (`exe::new_newsitem`) with `.home_club_id()`, `.away_club_id()`, the day and the year, to the managers of the home and away clubs that did not cancel (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`); of another competition: that competition's tournament among those at `friendly::TOURNAMENT_SLOTS` (0x69 bytes; index = competition byte − `friendly::FIRST_TOURNAMENT_COMP_ID`), if flagged, is cancelled (`exe::friendly_cancel_tournament` with 0). A friendly of this competition with the slot list (`friendly::SCHEDULED_SLOT_LIST`): the fixture's slot (`exe::friendly_find_scheduled_friendly_slot`) is freed (`scheduled_friendly_slot::OPPONENT` = 0, `scheduled_friendly_slot::STATUS` = 0). A fixture without a round (`.home_goals()` = 0xff): the national team one (`exe::database_is_national_team`) goes through `exe::friendly_remove_national_fixture`, the club one only leaves the calendar (`exe::fixture_manager_remove_fixture`).

Cancels a national team friendly (from `on_friendly_fixture_cancelled`; SEH frame for the local list and dates): the national team's fixture on the previous day leaves the calendar, then the fixture itself leaves. \n By the fixture flag (`.squad_rules()` & 0x300): 0x100 the national team is the home side (`.home_club()`), 0x200 the first national team of its nation (`exe::database_get_national_u21_team`); with a valid id, its fixture on the previous day (`exe::new_date`, `exe::date_sub_days` with 1, `exe::date_operator_3d`; `exe::fixture_manager_find_fixtures` with the previous day at both ends) leaves the calendar (`exe::fixture_manager_remove_fixture`). Then the fixture itself leaves.

`this.cancel_tournament(tournament, without_owner)` (SEH frame for the local news item, dates and list), called by the cancelled friendly (`on_friendly_fixture_cancelled`) and by the friendlies' day: cancels a friendly tournament. \n Without a tournament, the box of line 0x10ad. If the tournament starts after a week ago (`exe::date_sub_days` with 7), news item 0xb (the owner, the start day and year `tournament_slot::START_DATE`/+6) goes to the invited clubs (`tournament_slot::INVITED_CLUBS`, 4) that did not refuse (`tournament_slot::INVITE_PENDING` = 1, except the owner) and to the owner if `without_owner` is 0. The tournament leaves the pending list (`.pending_tournament_list()`, `exe::llist_remove`). With the competition created (`tournament_slot::COMPETITION`): its fixtures from a week before to 10 days after the start (`exe::fixture_manager_find_fixtures`): today's one becomes a friendly again (`exe::fixture_manager_find_stored_fixture`: `.set_stage_index(stage_index::MAIN)`, `.set_competition` = the friendlies competition, +0 = `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FRIENDLY`); the others leave the calendar (`exe::fixture_manager_remove_fixture`) and, those with a round, come back as friendlies (`exe::fixture_manager_insert_fixture`). The competition is destroyed (virtual +0 with 1) and `tournament_slot::COMPETITION` = 0. The slot in the competitions table (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`, `.first_tournament_comp_id()` + byte `tournament_slot::SLOT_INDEX`) and the owner (+0) are zeroed.

the national team friendlies on an international date: the nations with a match from 4 days before to 4 after become used (and each goes to the other one's list); then each free nation of the sorted list, in the date's confederation, looks for the first following free one that fits (a draw of 500, plus 1000 on the same continent, above 400, one of the two with `.number_staff()` >= 5, the pair not banned and no match between them in the year) and the friendly is added with a drawn home side

`friendly_check_match_invitation(a, b, club, day, year, data, text, size)` (SEH frame for the local LLIST `exe::new_llist`/`exe::drop_llist`), called by the invitation news item (0x77bc80, `exe::newsitem_get_action_button`): tells whether the friendly invitation still holds. \n With a text and a size (word) below 100: the box of line 0x1527 and 1 (the original). Without the date (`data`): with a text, club `a`'s fixtures (+0 id) on the day (day, year; `FN_FIXTURE_MANAGER_FIND_FIXTURES` into a local list) say whether the friendly was arranged (the first fixture is `a` against `b`) or cancelled (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF` into the text); returns 0. With the date: before today + 2 days (`exe::date_add_days`), cancelled (with text) and 0; the club free on the date (`FN_FRIENDLY_IS_CLUB_FREE_ON_DATE` with type 0): 1; otherwise, with text, "{} ... are unavailable" (byte `.short_gender_name()` twice and the name `club::SHORT_NAME`) and 0.

`friendly_check_tournament_invitation(club, tournament, text, size)`, called by the tournament invitation news item: tells whether the tournament invitation still holds. \n With a text and a size below 100: the box of line 0x1575 and 1 (the original). Without a tournament or with its date (`tournament_slot::START_DATE`) before today + 2 days: "This competition has been cancelled" (with text) and 0. The club free on the date (`FN_FRIENDLY_IS_CLUB_FREE_ON_DATE` with type `tournament_slot::KIND`): 1; otherwise, with text, "{} ... are unavailable for this competition." and 0.

`Friendly::build_international_date_table()`, called by the friendlies competition constructor (0x5c1f80, at game creation): builds the table of the 110 international dates. \n Count 0xc8 in `.intl_date_count()` and the 0xfa0-byte table (malloc `exe::crt_malloc`: push n; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) in `.intl_date_table()` (without memory: the box of line 0x15d5, count 0: the original); writes the 110 dates of 20 bytes (weekday, day, month, year offset from the World Cup year, confederation and qualifying competition; the first 105 directly, the last 5 through `exe::friendly_international_date_set`: mov ecx, entry; 6 pushes; no add esp -> thiscall, ret 0x18); with the count below 110 (never: it is the 0xc8 above) the box of line 0x15d8; count 110, the table shrunk to 0x898 bytes (realloc `exe::crt_realloc`: 2 pushes; add esp, 8 -> cdecl), the dates resolved in the World Cup cycle (`exe::friendly_resolve_international_dates`: mov ecx, esi; no push -> thiscall) and the last day done (`.intl_last_day_done()`) = 400.

`Friendly::resolve_international_dates()`, called by the table builder (`build_international_date_table`): gives each entry its date in the World Cup cycle and sorts the table by date. \n The World Cup year: the first one from today's year (`G_CURRENT_DATE_YEAR`) on with (year − 2) a multiple of 4. Each date (`.intl_date_table()`, count `.intl_date_count()`) gets its date at `intl_date_entry::DATE` through `exe::date_set` (lea ecx, entry + 3; 4 pushes; no add esp -> thiscall(date, day, month, year, weekday), ret 0x10) with the day (+1) and the weekday (+0) as signed bytes, the month (`intl_date_entry::MONTH`) and the World Cup year plus `intl_date_entry::YEAR_OFFSET` (signed), less 4 if it is more than 3 years ahead of today (words). Then the qsort by date (`exe::crt_qsort`: 4 pushes; add esp, 0x10 -> cdecl(table, count, 0x14, `compare_fixture_records_by_date`)).

`Friendly::find_human_club_tournament()`, called by the friendlies screens: returns the tournament in use that the current human manager's club hosts, or 0. \n The club (`.club_job()`) of the current human manager (`G_SCREEN_RECORDS_MANAGER` + 0x300 × `G_SCREEN_MANAGER_CURRENT_SLOT`); among the 127 tournaments (0x69 bytes from `friendly::TOURNAMENT_SLOTS`), the first with that host (+0) and in use (`tournament_slot::IN_USE` ≠ 0): its pointer; otherwise 0.

`this.plan_club_friendlies(entries, ordenados, count)`, called by the AI pre-season plan (`plan_ai_preseason_friendlies`): rebuilds the friendly plan (`.planned_friendlies()`), giving the AI clubs of each league in pre-season friendlies on free dates; at the end the plan is sorted by date. \n Frees the old plan (`.planned_friendlies()`; free `exe::crt_free`, cdecl), allocates the new one (malloc `exe::crt_malloc` of 2000 bytes, cdecl; without memory the box of line 0x6f1), capacity `.planned_capacity()` = 100, count `.planned_count()` and `.planned_next_index()` zeroed. For each of the 35 active leagues (`G_LEAGUE_TABLE`, 0x48 bytes) of a nation with `.league_selected()`, whose season (`key_nation_record::START_DATE`) has not started and whose date `key_nation_record::END_DATE` minus 0x34 (`exe::date_sub_weeks`: lea ecx, [league + 0x39]; 2 pushes; no add esp -> thiscall) has already arrived: the nation's candidates (bsearch `exe::crt_bsearch`: 5 pushes; add esp, 0x14 -> cdecl, through `compare_friendly_candidate_ptrs_by_nation`; it steps back to the nation's first one; the last one in the list never gets in) up to the first one of another nation. Each club that is not human (`FN_HUMAN_MANAGER_IS_HUMAN_CLUB`: 5 pushes; add esp, 0x14 -> cdecl(club, 1, 1, 0, 0)), is not the one with `.continental_comp_id()` = `KEY_CLUB_COMP_INTER_TOTO_CUP` and has a league (`.division()`) registered in `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`: band = `.reputation()` / 500 + (draw(3) + 1, where 3 becomes 2 when draw(4) is zero); up to draw(3) + 4 friendlies (by the candidate's count +4): the opponent (`exe::friendly_find_friendly_opponent`: 5 pushes; ecx = this -> thiscall) and, when found, the friendly on a free date (`exe::friendly_plan_friendly_on_free_date`: 3 pushes; ecx = this -> thiscall) with the one of higher band (+5) as host and home side; with no opponent or with the friendly booked, the band × 0.8 (`rdata::F64_0_8`; at least 1). At the end, the qsort of the plan by date (`exe::crt_qsort`: 4 pushes; add esp, 0x10 -> cdecl, through `compare_call_up_records_by_date`).

`this.add_tournament(host, kind, start, a, b, c, d, e, convidados, name)`, called by the AI tournament (0x5c3be0) and by the club screens (0x4701f0): fills the first free tournament of the 127, or returns 0 with no free slot. \n The tournament gets the host (+0), the type (`tournament_slot::KIND`), bytes a and b (+0xd, +0xe), the start date (`tournament_slot::START_DATE`, through `exe::date_operator_3d`: lea ecx, [t + 4]; 2 pushes; no add esp -> thiscall), words c, d, e (`tournament_slot::COMP_FLAGS_A`, `tournament_slot::COMP_FLAGS_B`, `tournament_slot::TEAM_COUNT`), `tournament_slot::IN_USE`, +0x2d and `tournament_slot::COMPETITION` zeroed, the name (`tournament_slot::NAME`, with the terminating zero) and the 4 invited clubs (`tournament_slot::INVITED_CLUBS`, dwords) with the flags `tournament_slot::INVITE_PENDING` (+0x25..+0x28) set to 1.

`Friendly::find_human_club_open_invitation()`, called by the friendlies screens: returns the friendly in the list (`.friendly_match_list()`) that the current human manager's club requested and that still waits for an opponent, or 0. \n With the friendlies list (`.friendly_match_list()`) and the club (`.club_job()`) of the current human manager (`G_SCREEN_RECORDS_MANAGER` + 0x300 × `G_SCREEN_MANAGER_CURRENT_SLOT`): the list cursor (`.set_cursor`) goes back to the start (`.head()`) and, walking with `exe::llist_get_next` (ecx = the list; no push -> thiscall), the first friendly of that club (`friendly_match::REQUESTING_CLUB`) still without a date (+8 ≠ 0); otherwise 0.

`this.process_friendly_reply(m, force)` (SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path): the invited club decides on a friendly request and the requester is told. \n Without a requester (`friendly_match::REQUESTING_CLUB`): nothing. With the other club (`friendly_match::HOME_CLUB`, or `friendly_match::AWAY_CLUB` if `friendly_match::HOME_CLUB` is the requester) in status 1 and without a human manager (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`), or with `force`: if either has no nation, status 4 (overwritten right after); the decision (`friendly_reply`: by reputation, with the nation, region, continent and stadium city distance factor) writes 3 or 4 into `friendly_match::STATUS` and news item 7 goes to the requester. Accepted (3): the friendly's match in a 0x4f-byte local (the competition [+4] and its id, the stadium of club `friendly_match::HOME_CLUB` (`club::STADIUM`) and its id, clubs `friendly_match::HOME_CLUB` and `friendly_match::AWAY_CLUB` and their ids, the request date, today's year, 9 for a national side (`exe::database_is_national_team`) or 1, kick-off time 1 on Saturday and Sunday (`exe::date_get_weekday` = 5 or 6) or 2, the flags, −1 in the scores) goes to the calendar (`exe::fixture_manager_add_fixture`: push 1; push &local; ecx = `G_FIXTURE_MANAGER` -> thiscall, ret 8). With 3 or 4: the booked friendly's slot (`exe::friendly_find_scheduled_friendly_slot`) gets `scheduled_friendly_slot::STATUS` = 3, or `scheduled_friendly_slot::OPPONENT` = 0 and `scheduled_friendly_slot::STATUS` = 0, and the request is removed (`FN_FRIENDLY_REMOVE_FRIENDLY_MATCH` with 0). In any other status, the request only leaves the reply list (`.request_reply_list()`; `FN_LLIST_REMOVE`, with the cursor `llist::CURSOR` reset to the start `llist::HEAD` before, after each one and at the end).

`this.send_friendly_request(m)` (SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path): stores the request on the reply list and notifies a human invited club. \n Without the reply list (`.request_reply_list()`), creates it (`exe::crt_operator_new`(0xe): push 0xe; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; `exe::new_llist`: ecx = the block -> thiscall, ret 0); without memory, the box (line 0x982) and nothing more. Stores the request pointer in the list (`exe::llist_add_tail`: push 4; push &request; ecx = the list -> thiscall, ret 8). With the other club in status 1 (`friendly_match::STATUS`) and with a human manager: status 2 and, if `friendly_match::HOME_CLUB` or `friendly_match::AWAY_CLUB` has a human manager, news item 6 to the other one.
